name: ad movere
source:
Ingrid is an aspiring young artist who is close to getting her big break! But, unfortunately, life throws many trials her way, and it's up to you to help her succeed!

ad movere is an experience that puts you into Ingrid's life. Help her make the right choice! Or everything and everyone she knows will be gone forever.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/840050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
英格丽德是一位有抱负的年轻艺术家，她即将取得重大突破！但不幸的是，生活给她带来了许多考验，而你需要帮助她取得成功！

ad movere是一种让你融入Ingrid生活的体验。帮助她做出正确的选择！或者她认识的一切和每个人都将永远消失。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/840050/]Steam[/url]]
